title: Crossing the Street Shouldn't Be Deadly (but it is)
summary: Not Just Bikes explains why crossing streets is dangerous in the US and Canada, where roads are designed to move cars fast, and contrasts it with Dutch designs for pedestrians.
why: Linked in road-safety threads as a good explanation of how street and signal design prevent pedestrian deaths.

quote.text: there's also just re-designing the streets to prevent the accidents in the first place
